# Apple Orchard India (appleorchard.in)

> Free apple orchard guide for growers in Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Uttarakhand and low-chill areas, by Gujarat Bio Organics. Built from Dr. YSP UHF Nauni, SKUAST-K, SKUAST-J, ICAR-CITH, NHB, MoA&FW and CIB&RC sources. English and Hindi.

## Key pages
- [Apple farming in India: orchard guide](https://appleorchard.in/)
- [Apple fertilizer schedule and calculator (bigha, kanal, nali)](https://appleorchard.in/fertilizer-schedule-and-calculator/)
- [Apple varieties, rootstocks and pollinizers](https://appleorchard.in/varieties-and-rootstocks/)
- [Apple root rot, collar rot and tree deaths](https://appleorchard.in/root-rot-and-tree-mortality/)
- [Alternate bearing, fruit drop and small fruit](https://appleorchard.in/alternate-bearing-and-fruit-quality/)
- [Apple spray schedule by stage](https://appleorchard.in/diseases-and-pests/spray-schedule/)
- [सेब की खेती (Hindi)](https://appleorchard.in/hi/seb-ki-kheti/)
